        from townlet.training.checkpoint_utils import safe_torch_load

        pack = tmp_path / "pack"
        shutil.copytree(root / "configs/test/bac_remediation/feedforward", pack, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".compiled"))
        training_path = pack / "levels/L0_0_minimal/training.yaml"
        document = yaml.safe_load(training_path.read_text())
        training = document["training"]
        training["population"]["size"] = 2
        training["replay_buffer"].update(capacity=64, batch_size=5, min_size=5)
        training["training_loop"].update(max_episodes=3, max_steps_per_episode=3, train_frequency=1)
        training["training_loop"]["checkpointing"]["interval"] = 1
        training["bac_options"]["rnd"]["max_pending_rows"] = 6
        training["bac_options"]["curiosity_scope"] = {"scope": "shared", "seed_policy": "legacy_shared_v1"}
        training_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(document, sort_keys=False))
        roster = WorldRosterDeclaration(("roundtrip-world-A", "roundtrip-world-B"))
        uninterrupted = tmp_path / "uninterrupted"
    
        def read_checkpoint(directory: Path, completed_episodes: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
            artifact = directory / "checkpoints" / f"checkpoint_ep{completed_episodes:05d}.pt"
            digest = artifact.with_suffix(".pt.sha256")
            assert hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest.read_text().strip()
            payload = safe_torch_load(artifact, allow_unsafe_pickle=True)
            assert payload["episode"] == completed_episodes
            assert payload["population_state"]["clock_ledger"]["completed_batch_episodes"] == completed_episodes
            return payload
    
        with DemoRunner(
            config_dir=pack,
            db_path=uninterrupted / "run.db",
            checkpoint_dir=uninterrupted / "checkpoints",
            world_roster=roster,
            level_name="L0_0_minimal",
            max_episodes=3,
        ) as runner:
            runner.run()
            saved = read_checkpoint(uninterrupted, 2)
            expected = read_checkpoint(uninterrupted, 3)
    
        saved_population = saved["population_state"]
        expected_population = expected["population_state"]
        saved_backend = saved_population["exploration_state"]["bank"]["shared_backend"]["native"]

        assert (saved_service["admitted_rows"], saved_service["consumed_rows"], saved_service["optimizer_updates"]) == (12, 10, 2)

        _learned(saved_backend, expected_backend)
        assert expected_population["training_step_counter"] > saved_population["training_step_counter"] > 0
        assert any(

        )
        assert expected_population["optimizer"]["state"]
    
        resumed = tmp_path / "resumed"
        (resumed / "checkpoints").mkdir(parents=True)
        shutil.copy2(uninterrupted / "run-world-roster.json", resumed / "run-world-roster.json")
        artifact = uninterrupted / "checkpoints/checkpoint_ep00002.pt"

    def load_checkpoint(self) -> int | None:
        """Load latest checkpoint if exists.
    
        Returns:
            Episode number of loaded checkpoint, or None if no checkpoint
            (or when force-new-VFS explicitly branches instead of resuming)
        """
        if self.env is None or self.population is None or self.curriculum is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Checkpoint load requires initialized env, population, and curriculum components.")
    
        env = self.env
        population = self.population
        curriculum = self.curriculum
    
        # Find latest checkpoint
        checkpoints = sorted(self.checkpoint_dir.glob("checkpoint_ep*.pt"))
        if not checkpoints:
            logger.info("No checkpoints found, starting from scratch")
            return None
    
        latest_checkpoint = checkpoints[-1]
        logger.info(f"Loading checkpoint: {latest_checkpoint}")
    
        verify_checkpoint_digest(latest_checkpoint, required=True)
        # The verified digest pins the trusted Python payload we unpickle below.
        checkpoint = safe_torch_load(latest_checkpoint, allow_unsafe_pickle=True)
        validate_demo_checkpoint_payload(checkpoint)
    
        # WS-1 task 5: the shared identity gate (format version, VFS ABI, dimensions,
        # content hashes, primary_level). The serving path runs the identical chain.
        if not assert_checkpoint_identity(checkpoint, self.compiled, force_new_vfs=self.force_new_vfs):
            return None
    
        # Validate every outer and nested runtime-bound value before mutation.
        validate_demo_checkpoint_runtime_fields(
            checkpoint,
            position_dim=env.substrate.position_dim,
            substrate_type=type(env.substrate).__name__,
            num_agents=population.num_agents,
        )
        completed_live_agent_steps = checkpoint["completed_live_agent_steps"]
        if self.max_environment_steps is not None and completed_live_agent_steps > self.max_environment_steps:
            raise ValueError(
                "Checkpoint completed_live_agent_steps exceeds this run's environment-step budget: "
                f"checkpoint={completed_live_agent_steps}, budget={self.max_environment_steps}."
            )
        validate_demo_native_boundary(checkpoint, cuda_devices=self.native_cuda_devices)
        native = checkpoint["native_boundary"]
        ledger = checkpoint["population_state"]["clock_ledger"]
        if (
            checkpoint["episode"] != ledger["completed_batch_episodes"]
            or completed_live_agent_steps != ledger["eligible_transitions"]
            or checkpoint["epsilon"] != checkpoint["population_state"]["exploration_state"]["selector"]["epsilon"]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Runner continuation fields disagree with the actual native population state")
        mode = "initial" if native["kind"] == "INITIAL" else "completed_boundary"
        plan = population.prepare_native_checkpoint_data(checkpoint["population_state"], mode=mode)
        replay_data = population.replay_buffer.stage_native_restore(
            population.native_replay_restore_state(plan=plan), expected_obs_dim=env.observation_dim, parent_plan=plan, lineage=None
        )
